about: AP Macroeconomics concept dependency map (docs/apmacro-spec.md, docs/apmacro-phase0.md): the 42 topics of the CED in order, the "Graph skills you need" topics (placed before Unit 1), and every concept with the topic that teaches it and the concepts it depends on. Built by Phase 0 from docs/apmacro-ced-map.json.

ced.edition: Course and Exam Description, effective fall 2025, unchanged for 2026-27 (6 units, 42 topics)
ced.note: Built from docs/apmacro-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apmacro-research/framework.md. Essential knowledge for 3.7 to 6.6 from scoring guidelines and Chief Reader Reports (docs/apmacro-needs-author.md, ced-text).

bigIdeas.name: Economic Measurements
bigIdeas.summary: How output, prices, unemployment and money are measured.

bigIdeas.name: Markets
bigIdeas.summary: How buyers and sellers set prices and quantities.

bigIdeas.name: Macroeconomic Models
bigIdeas.summary: Models (PPC, AD-AS, money and loanable funds markets, Phillips curves) that predict outcomes.

bigIdeas.name: Macroeconomic Policies
bigIdeas.summary: How fiscal and monetary policy change outcomes.

simulators.title: PPC and trade: PPC shapes and shifts, opportunity cost, comparative advantage from output and input data, terms of trade that help both sides

frqThemes.title: Two countries' PPCs: opportunity cost, comparative advantage and terms of trade that help both
frqThemes.author: A

frqThemes.title: A market after a change in input costs: the curve that shifts, the new price and quantity, and the shortage at the old price
frqThemes.author: A

chapters.title: Economic Indicators and the Business Cycle

simulators.title: Indicators lab: GDP by expenditure, CPI and inflation, the deflator, real versus nominal, unemployment types and rates

frqThemes.title: Labor force data: the unemployment and participation rates, discouraged workers, and the type of unemployment in a downturn
frqThemes.author: B

frqThemes.title: Nominal GDP and a price index over two years: the deflator, real GDP, and whether output grew
frqThemes.author: B

simulators.title: Multiplier lab: spending, tax and balanced-budget multipliers, closing a gap (divide, direction first), the money multiplier
AD-AS lab: short-run shocks and long-run self-adjustment with the cause, linked to the Phillips curve
Make it specific: a causal chain built link by link (policy, rate, spending, AD, output and price level) and checked against a rubric

frqThemes.title: A recessionary gap: AD-AS with LRAS, the fiscal policy and multiplier that close it, the money market and the long-run self-adjustment if nothing is done
frqThemes.author: C

frqThemes.title: An MPC and a gap: the spending and tax multipliers, the change in spending that closes the gap, and why a tax cut must be larger
frqThemes.author: C

frqThemes.title: An inflationary gap left alone: what shifts in the long run and why, with the new price level and output
frqThemes.author: C

simulators.title: Reserves lab: ample versus limited reserves, the reserve market and money market side by side, every Fed tool

frqThemes.title: A central bank with ample reserves fights a recession: the administered rate, the reserve market graph, investment, AD and the price level, then the loanable funds market
frqThemes.author: D

frqThemes.title: Limited reserves and an inflationary gap: the open market operation, the money market, bond prices, AD and unemployment
frqThemes.author: D

frqThemes.title: A bank balance sheet: required and excess reserves, the most one bank can lend and the most the money supply can change
frqThemes.author: D

frqThemes.title: A rise in the price level: money demand, the nominal interest rate and bond prices
frqThemes.author: D

simulators.title: Policy chain: the causal chain for fiscal, monetary and open-economy shocks, link by link

frqThemes.title: A negative supply shock: AD-AS, the short- and long-run Phillips curves, expected inflation and the path back to the natural rate
frqThemes.author: E

frqThemes.title: Deficit spending at full employment: AD-AS, the loanable funds market, crowding out and long-run growth on the PPC
frqThemes.author: E

frqThemes.title: A demand shock on the Phillips curves: the short-run move and where the economy ends in the long run
frqThemes.author: E

frqThemes.title: Government borrowing: the real interest rate, private investment and the capital stock
frqThemes.author: E

chapters.title: Open Economy: International Trade and Finance

simulators.title: Forex lab: currency axes the right way round, demand and supply shifts, appreciation, net exports and capital flows

frqThemes.title: Higher real interest rates in one country: loanable funds, capital flows, the foreign exchange market, the currency and net exports
frqThemes.author: F

frqThemes.title: Balance of payments entries: the current account, the capital and financial account and why they sum to zero
frqThemes.author: F

frqThemes.title: Higher inflation abroad: the market for the dollar, appreciation and net exports
frqThemes.author: F
